title: Per-character memory summaries require reliable scene-presence metadata
symptom: DMM warns that without Presence integration it cannot determine who saw which messages; its generated summaries may include unseen scenes.
user_impact: An apparently isolated memory system can accidentally share scene secrets if its dependency is missing or disabled.

steps: Enable Presence and check DMM's warning banner; confirm each chat message has a present-attendee list before summarizing.

remaining_question: What happens after extension updates or imported chat files without presence metadata?
verification_plan: Create group chats with and without Presence metadata; inspect generated per-character memory summaries and error handling.
